paragraphs.en: Secreted away inside a windowless building at 7700 Potranco Road in San Antonio, Texas, is a darkened room that serves as the hub of Task Force Raider. This military task force is secretly at work as part of a government-wide “election security group,” guarding against “interference” in the upcoming midterm elections.
paragraphs.zh: 在得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市波特兰科路7700号一栋没有窗户的建筑里，隐藏着一间灯光昏暗的房间，它是“突袭者特遣部队”的指挥中枢。 这支军事特遣部队正在作为政府范围内“选举安全小组”的一部分秘密开展工作，防范即将到来的中期选举中的“干预”行为。

sents.en: Secreted away inside a windowless building at 7700 Potranco Road in San Antonio, Texas, is a darkened room that serves as the hub of Task Force Raider.
sents.zh: 在得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市波特兰科路7700号一栋没有窗户的建筑里，隐藏着一间灯光昏暗的房间，它是“突袭者特遣部队”的指挥中枢。

sents.en: This military task force is secretly at work as part of a government-wide “election security group,” guarding against “interference” in the upcoming midterm elections.
sents.zh: 这支军事特遣部队正在作为政府范围内“选举安全小组”的一部分秘密开展工作，防范即将到来的中期选举中的“干预”行为。

paragraphs.en: Interference, however, is a loaded word. While it connotes the Kremlin hacking into polling places or changing the election count, Task Force Raider is actually more focused on the broader category of “influence”, specifically Russian or Chinese attempts to change minds rather than to change votes.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，「干预」是一个含义沉重的词。 虽然这个词让人联想到克里姆林宫黑客入侵投票站或篡改计票结果，但「掠夺者」特遣部队实际上更关注更宽泛的「影响力」范畴，具体指俄罗斯或中国试图改变人们的想法而非改变选票的行为。

sents.zh: 然而，「干预」是一个含义沉重的词。

sents.en: While it connotes the Kremlin hacking into polling places or changing the election count, Task Force Raider is actually more focused on the broader category of “influence”, specifically Russian or Chinese attempts to change minds rather than to change votes.
sents.zh: 虽然这个词让人联想到克里姆林宫黑客入侵投票站或篡改计票结果，但「掠夺者」特遣部队实际上更关注更宽泛的「影响力」范畴，具体指俄罗斯或中国试图改变人们的想法而非改变选票的行为。

paragraphs.en: But the real target is the American people, whom the federal government sees as vectors for foreign influence.
paragraphs.zh: 但真正的目标是美国人民，联邦政府将他们视为外国影响的传播载体。

paragraphs.en: “The entire election security scare is to indulge President Trump and assuage Democrats, all of whom fear interference and shenanigans, but not from foreign shores,” says a senior military intelligence officer, who spoke to me about the secret effort.
paragraphs.zh: “整个选举安全的恐慌是为了纵容特朗普总统并安抚民主党人——他们都担心干预和暗中捣鬼，但并非来自海外，”一位高级军事情报官说，他曾向我谈及这一秘密行动。

paragraphs.en: He and other military officers expressed unease with the sprawling mission. It encompasses everything from sending millions of anonymous text and voice messages abroad, to outright deleting social media posts or taking down entire websites, as documents I obtained reveal.
paragraphs.zh: 他和其他军官对这一铺开过大的任务表达了不安。 正如我获取的文件所揭示的，它涵盖从向海外发送数百万条匿名短信和语音消息，到直接删除社交媒体帖子或下线整个网站的各种行动。

sents.en: He and other military officers expressed unease with the sprawling mission.
sents.zh: 他和其他军官对这一铺开过大的任务表达了不安。

paragraphs.en: Entrance to Task Force Raider’s base of operations All of this is in violation of longstanding prohibitions against any military involvement in elections whatsoever, yet enjoys the support of both major political parties.
paragraphs.zh: 突袭者特遣队（Task Force Raider）作战基地的入口，这一切都违反了长期以来禁止军队以任何形式介入选举的禁令，然而却得到了两大政党的支持。

paragraphs.en: What’s more, for all the handwringing about election interference, the Trump administration hasn’t substantiated that any country (or any other foreigners) are planning to interfere or have any chance of meaningfully altering an outcome. But that hasn’t stopped the federal government from designating election security the number one “operational priority” — a mission that insiders are calling “no fail.”
paragraphs.zh: 更何况，尽管各方对选举干预忧心忡忡，特朗普政府并未证实任何国家（或任何其他外国人）正计划进行干预，或有任何可能实质性地改变选举结果。 但这并没有阻止联邦政府将选举安全列为头号“行动优先事项”——一项内部人士称之为“不容有失”的使命。

paragraphs.en: That is the mission directive that Pete Hegseth issued to the San Antonio cyber establishment last week, as I reported on recently. Yet because Hegseth’s war is highly classified, takes place in cyberspace and entails a healthy dose of covert actions that would shut down potential attacks as well as cut off normal influencers and common citizens who seek to sway voters (what some might call ‘democracy’), nothing has been written about Hegseth’s actual election interference.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我最近报道的那样，这就是皮特·赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）上周向圣安东尼奥网络机构下达的任务指令。 然而，由于赫格塞斯的这场战争属于高度机密、发生在网络空间，并包含大量秘密行动——这些行动既会阻止潜在的攻击，也会切断那些试图影响选民的影响者和普通民众（有些人可能会称之为“民主”）——因此，关于赫格塞斯实际干预选举的情况至今没有任何报道。

paragraphs.en: “These are not merely Keystone Cops battling against pimple-faced amateurs and anarchists,” says a retired senior military officer who has been involved in election security since the 2016 presidential year. “Every capability that the US possesses, in Cyber Command, the CIA, NSA, and other agencies, the Russian and Chinese governments also have,” he says. “We are literally involved in a daily battle in cyberspace.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们不仅仅是与满脸粉刺的业余爱好者和无政府主义者作斗争的愚蠢警察，”一位自2016年总统大选年以来一直参与选举安全事务的退役高级军官说。“美国所拥有的每一种能力，无论是网络司令部、中央情报局、国家安全局还是其他机构的，俄罗斯和中国政府也同样拥有，”他说。“我们实际上每天都在网络空间中进行着一场战斗。”

paragraphs.en: Despite this underground war, the officer questions the growing military involvement in safeguarding voting. “Influencing the influencers? That’s creating a precedent that I’m not comfortable with,” he said. As he sees it, this is not just a slippery slope to boots on the ground at polling places but of building and having federal government capabilities that will eventually be able to control public speech and assembly.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这场地下战争，这名军官仍对军方日益介入保护投票一事提出质疑。“影响那些有影响力的人？ 这是在开创一个让我感到不安的先例，”他说。 在他看来，这不仅仅是一条通往在投票站驻军的不归路，更是建立并拥有联邦政府能力的一条不归路，而这种能力最终将能够控制公众的言论和集会。

paragraphs.en: The officer, who describes himself as a nonpartisan believer that the Constitution always comes first, points out that the hundred-plus-year prohibition against posting federal soldiers at polling places had good reason behind it then and good reason now.
paragraphs.zh: 这位警官自称是一位无党派人士，坚信宪法永远至上。他指出，禁止联邦士兵驻扎在投票站这项已有一百多年历史的禁令，当年有充分的理由，如今也同样有充分的理由。

paragraphs.en: “Granted, those in uniform are subordinate to an interagency civilian effort,” he says, “but the construct of only fearing boots on the ground is obsolete. We need to update our thinking, and the law, to include the cyber world. And we need to counter the idea that a robust, even foreign-based debate, requires federal intervention.”
paragraphs.zh: “诚然，穿制服的人员从属于跨部门的文职工作，”他说，“但只害怕地面部队的观念已经过时了。 我们需要更新思维和法律，将网络世界纳入其中。 我们还需要反驳那种认为激烈甚至来自国外的辩论就需要联邦干预的观点。”

paragraphs.en: To understand how close we are to abridging the First Amendment, consider that earlier this month, Senators Adam Schiff and Alex Padilla of California wrote to the heads of half a dozen social media companies to warn that they — YouTube, Twitter (X), Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Google — weren’t doing enough to “combat misinformation and disinformation … during the 2026 midterm elections.” It was a wholly partisan letter with a predictable dose of Donald Trump this and Donald Trump that. But there it was: two prominent Democrats and liberals threatening that Congress must “consider investigations and legislation to remedy” election mis- and disinformation.
paragraphs.zh: 要了解我们距离削减第一修正案保障的自由有多近，可以看看本月早些时候，加利福尼亚州参议员亚当·希夫和亚历克斯·帕迪利亚致函六家社交媒体公司的负责人，警告他们——YouTube、Twitter（X）、Facebook、Instagram、TikTok 和 Google——在“2026 年中期选举期间打击错误信息和虚假信息”方面做得还不够。这是一封彻头彻尾的党派信件，其中可以预见地充斥着对特朗普这也不是、那也不是的指责。 但它就摆在那里：两位显赫的民主党自由派人士威胁说，国会必须“考虑通过调查和立法来纠正”选举中的错误信息和虚假信息。

paragraphs.en: “Congress shall make no law,” the military officer says, when asked about the proposed legislation. “It’s the first sentence of the First Amendment to the Constitution. Period.”
paragraphs.zh: “国会不得立法，”这位军官在被问及拟议立法时说道。“这是宪法第一修正案的第一句话。就这样。”

paragraphs.en: Now, however, a law, and control, is the norm. And Hegseth, for whatever reason, wants the Pentagon in on the action, that is, under the misleading guise that it is only working against “foreign” actors.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，如今法律和管制已成常态。 而赫格塞斯，不知出于何种原因，想让五角大楼也参与其中，也就是说，以“只针对‘外国’行为者”这一具有误导性的名义行事。

paragraphs.en: The military has been quietly involved in protecting federal elections against cyber attack since Donald Trump appeared on the national stage in 2016, in the context of WikiLeaks, Kremlin influence operations and their hacking of Hillary Clinton’s emails.
paragraphs.zh: 自2016年唐纳德·特朗普登上国家舞台以来，在维基解密、克里姆林宫影响行动及其入侵希拉里·克林顿电子邮件的背景下，军方一直在悄悄参与保护联邦选举免受网络攻击。

paragraphs.en: Whether any of what happened was important enough to have the slightest impact on the American vote or not, the Obama White House was spooked enough that it gave the CIA covert action authorities to shut down websites and social media accounts — including taking a Russian military-created website called “DCleaks” offline — that might release additional materials. Whatever you think about Obama’s motivations or Trump’s, the essence of the government action then, as it is now, is that it restricts free speech.
paragraphs.zh: 无论已发生的事情中是否有任何一件重要到足以对美国的投票产生哪怕最轻微的影响，奥巴马政府都已被吓得够呛，以至于授予中央情报局隐蔽行动权限，去关闭可能发布更多材料的网站和社交媒体账号——包括将一个由俄罗斯军方创建的名为"DCleaks"的网站下线。 无论你怎么看待奥巴马的动机或特朗普的动机，当时政府行动的本质——正如现在一样——都是在限制言论自由。

paragraphs.en: Task Force Raider (or its predecessor) was mobilized to assist Homeland Security and the FBI in “defending” the United States. To pull together the right people with the greatest talent, the Task Force operates under a “best athlete” approach, picking the most qualified individual regardless of military service, civilian agency or defense contractors. Eventually, over 350 people got to work on the task force.
paragraphs.zh: 突袭者特遣部队（或其前身机构）被动员起来，协助国土安全部和联邦调查局“保卫”美国。 为了聚集最具才华的合适人才，该特遣部队采用“最佳选手”策略，选拔最合格的个人，而不论其来自哪个军种、民间机构或国防承包商。 最终，有超过350人加入了该特遣部队的工作。

paragraphs.en: A $10 million Rewards for Justice program was unveiled, and over 56,000 “psychological operations” (PSYOPS) messages were posted over the internet. The influence warriors of Task Force Raider sent over three million (!) text and voice messages to people in “countries of interest,” according to documents I’ve obtained. All of this took place in secret.
paragraphs.zh: 美国公布了价值1000万美元的“正义奖励”（Rewards for Justice）计划，并在互联网上发布了超过56,000条“心理战”（PSYOPS）信息。 根据我获取的文件，“掠夺者特遣队”（Task Force Raider）的影响力战士向“值得关注的国家”的人们发送了超过三百万条（！）短信和语音信息。 所有这一切都是在秘密状态下进行的。

sents.en: A $10 million Rewards for Justice program was unveiled, and over 56,000 “psychological operations” (PSYOPS) messages were posted over the internet.
sents.zh: 美国公布了价值1000万美元的“正义奖励”（Rewards for Justice）计划，并在互联网上发布了超过56,000条“心理战”（PSYOPS）信息。

sents.en: The influence warriors of Task Force Raider sent over three million (!) text and voice messages to people in “countries of interest,” according to documents I’ve obtained.
sents.zh: 根据我获取的文件，“掠夺者特遣队”（Task Force Raider）的影响力战士向“值得关注的国家”的人们发送了超过三百万条（！）短信和语音信息。

sents.en: All of this took place in secret.
sents.zh: 所有这一切都是在秘密状态下进行的。

paragraphs.en: Some of the work and preparations were focused purely on defense. One unit, the “Demon Chasers” of the “91st Cyber Operations Squadron,” the military’s premier offensive cyberspace squadron, contributes its expertise to the mix. Working from their 42,600-square-foot “multi-domain” secure facility that contracting documents say is authorized to handle Top Secret “sensitive activities” (SA), “sensitive compartmented information” (SCI), “special access program” (SAP) level information, offensive cyber operations (OCO), and “special technical operations” (STO), the 91st specializes in freezing out communications.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一些工作和准备工作纯粹专注于防御。 有一支部队——“第91网络作战中队”的“驱魔人”——是军方首屈一指的进攻性网络空间中队，也为这一整体贡献了自己的专长。 第91中队在一座42,600平方英尺的“多域”保密设施内工作，合同文件显示该设施获准处理“绝密”级“敏感活动”（SA）、“敏感分隔信息”（SCI）、“特殊访问计划”（SAP）级别的信息、进攻性网络作战（OCO）以及“特种技术作战”（STO），该中队擅长于冻结、切断通信。

sents.en: Some of the work and preparations were focused purely on defense.
sents.zh: 其中一些工作和准备工作纯粹专注于防御。

sents.en: One unit, the “Demon Chasers” of the “91st Cyber Operations Squadron,” the military’s premier offensive cyberspace squadron, contributes its expertise to the mix.
sents.zh: 有一支部队——“第91网络作战中队”的“驱魔人”——是军方首屈一指的进攻性网络空间中队，也为这一整体贡献了自己的专长。

sents.en: Working from their 42,600-square-foot “multi-domain” secure facility that contracting documents say is authorized to handle Top Secret “sensitive activities” (SA), “sensitive compartmented information” (SCI), “special access program” (SAP) level information, offensive cyber operations (OCO), and “special technical operations” (STO), the 91st specializes in freezing out communications.
sents.zh: 第91中队在一座42,600平方英尺的“多域”保密设施内工作，合同文件显示该设施获准处理“绝密”级“敏感活动”（SA）、“敏感分隔信息”（SCI）、“特殊访问计划”（SAP）级别的信息、进攻性网络作战（OCO）以及“特种技术作战”（STO），该中队擅长于冻结、切断通信。

paragraphs.en: One document says that the squadron, and its Special Program Office, has the mission to “degrade, disrupt, deceive and exploit adversary telephony and information system.” It cut its teeth in Afghanistan, where it perfected “cellular coverage blackouts,” that is, the ability to shut down cellphone communications in a limited area.
paragraphs.zh: 一份文件显示，该中队及其特种项目办公室的任务是“削弱、破坏、欺骗并利用敌方的电话系统与信息系统”。它在阿富汗积累了实战经验，在那里完善了“蜂窝信号覆盖屏蔽”技术，即在有限区域内切断手机通信的能力。

paragraphs.en: Another unit operates a “malware lab” that collects together software and data from all sorts of adversary hacks and cyber operations, conducting analysis of “malicious artifacts,” and writing counter-software to thwart incoming attacks and implants.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个部门运营着一个“恶意软件实验室”，收集来自各种对手攻击和网络行动的软件与数据，对“恶意产物”进行分析，并编写反制软件以挫败来袭的攻击和植入体。

paragraphs.en: An enormous part of the overall effort is “persona operations” — where soldiers and other literal keyboard warriors create false identities and fake internet addresses to operate in cyberspace without government attribution, to scout the web and surf social media, to engage individual users, and to do some influencing of their own.
paragraphs.zh: 整体工作中相当大的一部分是「人设行动」——士兵和其他真正的键盘战士创建虚假身份和假互联网地址，以便在没有政府归因的情况下在网络空间中活动，侦察网络、浏览社交媒体，与个别用户互动，并自己进行一些影响力操作。

paragraphs.en: My sources who are privy to this Top Secret effort all agree: the military is not just thwarting foreign actors from sowing discontent. They are also regulating what appears in social media, regulating legitimate debate.
paragraphs.zh: 我那些知悉这一绝密行动的消息人士都一致认为：军方不只是在阻止外国行为者散播不满情绪。 他们还在监管社交媒体上出现的内容，监管正当的辩论。

sents.en: My sources who are privy to this Top Secret effort all agree: the military is not just thwarting foreign actors from sowing discontent.
sents.zh: 我那些知悉这一绝密行动的消息人士都一致认为：军方不只是在阻止外国行为者散播不满情绪。

sents.en: They are also regulating what appears in social media, regulating legitimate debate.
sents.zh: 他们还在监管社交媒体上出现的内容，监管正当的辩论。

paragraphs.en: Cyber Command’s (CYBERCOM’s) Joint Force Headquarters – Cyber, operating from its war room inside the National Security Agency-Texas facility in San Antonio, oversees Task Force Raider and other military election security efforts. On the million-square-foot “security hill,” not far from the NSA facility at the former Kelly Air Force Base, another unit has built a “state-of-the-art weapons system to mimic the collection efforts of foreign intelligence services,” according to documents I’ve obtained.
paragraphs.zh: 网络司令部（CYBERCOM）联合部队总部——网络，在位于圣安东尼奥的国家安全局得克萨斯 facility 的作战室内运作，负责监管「突袭者特遣队」及其他军事选举安全工作。 据我获取的文件显示，在前凯利空军基地的国家安全局 facility 不远处、占地一百万平方英尺的「安全山」上，另一支部队建立了一套「最先进的武器系统，用以模拟外国情报机构的情报收集行动」。

sents.en: Cyber Command’s (CYBERCOM’s) Joint Force Headquarters – Cyber, operating from its war room inside the National Security Agency-Texas facility in San Antonio, oversees Task Force Raider and other military election security efforts.
sents.zh: 网络司令部（CYBERCOM）联合部队总部——网络，在位于圣安东尼奥的国家安全局得克萨斯 facility 的作战室内运作，负责监管「突袭者特遣队」及其他军事选举安全工作。

sents.en: On the million-square-foot “security hill,” not far from the NSA facility at the former Kelly Air Force Base, another unit has built a “state-of-the-art weapons system to mimic the collection efforts of foreign intelligence services,” according to documents I’ve obtained.
sents.zh: 据我获取的文件显示，在前凯利空军基地的国家安全局 facility 不远处、占地一百万平方英尺的「安全山」上，另一支部队建立了一套「最先进的武器系统，用以模拟外国情报机构的情报收集行动」。

paragraphs.en: After the 2020 elections, the Joint Force Headquarters activated an election security “enclave” to support “the most sensitive activities.” The Pentagon defines such activities as “activities that, if compromised, could cause enduring adverse effects on U.S. foreign policy or military operations, or lead to significant embarrassment for the U.S. government, its allies, or the military.”
paragraphs.zh: 2020年大选结束后，联合部队总部启用了一个选举安全“飞地”，以支持“最敏感的活动”。五角大楼将此类活动定义为“一旦泄露，可能对美国外交政策或军事行动造成持久不利影响，或使美国政府、盟友或军方陷入严重难堪境地的活动”。

paragraphs.en: In other words, actions that might damage the federal government and the military, not actions that might damage democracy.
paragraphs.zh: 换言之，是可能损害联邦政府和军队的行为，而不是可能损害民主的行为。

paragraphs.en: Online support for Palestinians and opposition to Israel’s conduct in the Gaza war; vitriol against Donald Trump, or ICE, or the CIA and the FBI; or “disinformation” in general? None of these are a serious threat to our democracy. Yet somehow the federal government and the Pentagon have convinced us that they need to take extreme action, including controlling speech, to counter it.
paragraphs.zh: 网上对巴勒斯坦人的支持以及对以色列在加沙战争中的行为的反对；对唐纳德·特朗普、移民及海关执法局（ICE）、中央情报局和联邦调查局的恶意攻击；或者一般意义上的“虚假信息”？ 这些都不是对我们民主的严重威胁。 然而不知为何，联邦政府和五角大楼却让我们相信，他们需要采取极端行动，包括控制言论，来对抗它。

sents.en: Online support for Palestinians and opposition to Israel’s conduct in the Gaza war; vitriol against Donald Trump, or ICE, or the CIA and the FBI; or “disinformation” in general?
sents.zh: 网上对巴勒斯坦人的支持以及对以色列在加沙战争中的行为的反对；对唐纳德·特朗普、移民及海关执法局（ICE）、中央情报局和联邦调查局的恶意攻击；或者一般意义上的“虚假信息”？

sents.en: Yet somehow the federal government and the Pentagon have convinced us that they need to take extreme action, including controlling speech, to counter it.

paragraphs.en: What Americans see of military involvement in the election, they pretty clearly don’t like. When video circulated of DC National Guardsmen appearing in front of a ballot drop box, it quickly went viral, stoking outrage.
paragraphs.zh: 美国人对军方介入选举所看到的情况，他们显然是不喜欢的。 当华盛顿特区国民警卫队队员出现在投票箱前的视频流传开来后，迅速走红，激起了民众的愤怒。

sents.zh: 美国人对军方介入选举所看到的情况，他们显然是不喜欢的。

sents.en: When video circulated of DC National Guardsmen appearing in front of a ballot drop box, it quickly went viral, stoking outrage.

paragraphs.en: What people don’t see is that the military is also eyeing the vote in a much more systematic way in cyberspace. Why isn’t anyone asking what they are actually doing? And who is the actual target? And what is it that they have in mind to do on or before election day to carry out their own influence campaign?
paragraphs.zh: 人们没有看到的是，军方也在以更加系统化的方式在网络空间盯上选票。 为什么没有人问他们实际上在做什么？ 而真正的目标又是谁？ 他们打算在选举日当天或之前做些什么来开展自己的影响力行动？
